directAnswer: To connect a domain name, you need to update the DNS settings at your domain registrar to point to your web hosting provider's servers.
summary: This guide outlines the steps to connect your domain name to a web hosting service, including platform-specific instructions and common pitfalls.

sections.heading: Understanding DNS
sections.body: DNS (Domain Name System) translates your domain name into an IP address that directs users to your website. Proper configuration is essential for your domain to function correctly.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: Instructions may vary depending on your domain registrar and web hosting provider. Below are general steps for popular platforms.

sections.heading: Common Caveats
sections.body: Be aware that DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate fully across the internet.

steps.title: Log into your domain registrar
steps.detail: Access your account on the website where you purchased your domain (e.g., GoDaddy, Namecheap).

steps.title: Locate DNS settings
steps.detail: Find the DNS management section. This may be labeled as 'DNS Settings', 'Name Server Management', or similar.

steps.title: Update Name Servers
steps.detail: Replace the existing name servers with those provided by your web hosting provider. This information is typically found in your hosting account dashboard.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.detail: Ensure you save any changes made to the DNS settings. You may receive a confirmation message.

faqs.question: How long does it take for DNS changes to take effect?
faqs.answer: DNS changes can take anywhere from a few minutes to 48 hours to propagate globally.

faqs.question: What if my website doesn't load after changing DNS settings?
faqs.answer: Double-check that the name servers are entered correctly and that they match those provided by your hosting provider.

faqs.question: Can I connect my domain to multiple websites?
faqs.answer: No, a single domain can only point to one website at a time unless you use subdomains or URL forwarding.

caveats: DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate fully.
Ensure you have the correct name server information from your hosting provider.
